correctness.rationale: Braden--Disney-Hogg give the exact sixty-point labeling and class-(i) tritangent contact divisors. From those formulas, the three fibre families and all incidence counts follow. A tritangent hyperplane section has degree six and its three double contacts exhaust that divisor, excluding extra point-plane incidences. The embedded exhaustive checker proves that the collinearity graph is A(5,3), that its sixty maximal cliques are exactly the sixty blocks, and that it has exactly 720 automorphisms, all accounted for by commuting S5 and S3 actions. The cubic is independently checked irreducible with discriminant -200 and Galois group S3.

value.rationale: The sixty all-Weierstrass tritangents are a canonical half of Bring's odd-theta/tritangent system, not an arbitrary slice. The result upgrades three separate twenty-element S5 orbits into one intrinsic resolvable incidence geometry, shows that the whole class-(i) system is reconstructible from the arrangement graph A(5,3), and explains the symmetry enlargement from the geometric S5 to S5 x S3 by the Galois action on the cubic root labels. This supplies a compact structural model for a distinguished finite configuration on the maximally symmetric genus-four curve.
